name: hierarchical-teams
title: Hierarchical Agent Teams

comparison.purpose: LLM supervisors that dynamically route among workers and loop, at two levels: a research-team supervisor (agent.decide) routes SEARCH/SCRAPE/FINISH over a bounded worker budget, under a coordinator supervisor that invokes the team machines through typed boundaries and can send one bounded revision round back to research.

starters: The impact of RISC-V on the data center market.
How tokenization affects LLM reasoning on math problems.
